title: Job Bank
description: USI Alumni can post job announcements, can browse internships and job offers posted daily on the Career Service job bank and can still receive the Career Newsletter.

blocks.html: USI Alumni can post job announcements, can browse internships and job offers posted daily on the Career Service job bank and can still receive the Career Newsletter.

items.title: Post an offer
items.html:
If you are looking for new hires for your organization, you can post your job/internship offer in the Career Service job platform, accessible to all current students and graduates. The posting is free.

Post a job offer

Please remember that the internship follows different regulations according to the country’s laws; the Career Service is available for further information and support. Also, remember that any possible internship or job contract agreed and signed between a company and a student/graduate shall be binding for these two parties only.

items.title: Job offers
items.html:
Search in the job bank

Please remember that the data bank is a tool designed to support the search for an internship or a job: students and graduates are nonetheless fully responsible for their own search.
These opportunities are targeted at students or recent graduates who obtained their degree no more than a year ago.

Also, remember that any internship or job contract agreed upon and signed between a company and a student/graduate is binding only for these two parties; the same applies to work permits.

items.title: Career newsletter & SXS newsletter
items.html:
Each week a newsletter with a summary of all the latest internship offers and job opportunities for USI students and graduates, career events and the presentation of the weekly USI career story on spotlight is published online and sent to all USI students, new graduates and graduates who request it.

Opportunities in Space

Interested in space? You can find information regarding exchange, mobility and careers opportunities in the space field on the SXS platform, a new national platform for the promotion and support of further developments of space in Switzerland founded by the Swiss Space Office (SSO) of the State Secretariat for Education, Research and Innovation (SERI) and implemented on a national scale by a consortium of 5 project partners: EPFL Lausanne, University of Zurich, ETH Zurich, FHNM and USI.

If you want to be updated, you are kindly invited to register on the SXS mailing list via this form.
